verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party documented public API. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all return 404, and llama.com's developer docs sit behind an SSO wall. The official llama-models CLI only lists, downloads and verifies weights; it does not drive inference. Programmatic access comes only indirectly, through third-party hosts (AWS, Azure, GCP and others) whose APIs carry 'request parameters' that depend on each implementation. Missing for 10: a first-party public inference API, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, publicly readable developer docs, and hands-on evidence of driving Llama through any documented endpoint.
